CREATE TABLE `project` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`goal` text NOT NULL,
	`constraints` text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "project_singleton" CHECK("project"."id" = 1)
);
CREATE TABLE `milestones` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`objective` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	`dependencies` text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `tasks` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`milestone` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`spec` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	`result` text,
	`position` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`milestone`) REFERENCES `milestones`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE TABLE `history` (
	`seq` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`at` integer NOT NULL,
	`session` text NOT NULL,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`subject` text NOT NULL,
	`payload` text NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX `history_subject` ON `history` (`subject`,`seq`);
CREATE TABLE `activity` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`task` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer,
	`run` text NOT NULL,
	`parent` text,
	`actor` text NOT NULL,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`started` integer NOT NULL,
	`ended` integer,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	`input` text,
	`output` text
);
CREATE INDEX `activity_task` ON `activity` (`task`,`started`);
CREATE TABLE `writes` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`task` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`path` text NOT NULL,
	`before_hash` text,
	`after_hash` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`description` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`operation_id` text
);
CREATE INDEX `writes_created` ON `writes` (`created_at`);
CREATE TABLE `workspaces` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`data` text NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `lease` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`pid` integer NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "lease_singleton" CHECK("lease"."id" = 1)
);
CREATE TABLE `main_responses` (
	`session` text NOT NULL,
	`timestamp` integer NOT NULL,
	`text` text NOT NULL,
	`metadata` text NOT NULL,
	`issue` text,
	PRIMARY KEY(`session`, `timestamp`)
);
CREATE TABLE `command_runs` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`task` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`started` integer NOT NULL,
	`ended` integer,
	`cwd` text NOT NULL,
	`command` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	`exit_code` integer,
	`signal` text
);
CREATE INDEX `command_task` ON `command_runs` (`task`,`revision`,`started`);
CREATE TABLE `command_logs` (
	`seq` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`run` text NOT NULL,
	`stream` text NOT NULL,
	`text` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`run`) REFERENCES `command_runs`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE INDEX `command_log_run` ON `command_logs` (`run`,`seq`);
CREATE TABLE `directory_changes` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`task` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`path` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`description` text NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `preferences` (
	`key` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`value` text NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `work_state` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`selected` text,
	`source_epoch` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`run` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`selected`) REFERENCES `tasks`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	CONSTRAINT "state_singleton" CHECK("work_state"."id" = 1)
);
CREATE TABLE `check_definitions` (
	`name` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`definition` text NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `check_results` (
	`run` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`definition` text NOT NULL,
	`source_epoch` integer NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`run`) REFERENCES `command_runs`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
